## Eversource Energy Invites Public to Listen to Webcast of Wolfe Research Conference


September 15, 2026


[PDF Version](https://investors.eversource.com/node/38101/pdf)


HARTFORD, Conn. and BOSTON, Sept. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Eversource Energy invites investors and the general public to listen to a webcast of a discussion with Joe Nolan, Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer, at the Wolfe Research Utilities, Midstream & Clean Energy Conference 2026 on Wednesday, September 30, 2026 at 9:20 a.m. EDT.


To listen to the webcast, visit our website at[Eversource's Investors page](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=w4IzImjn5hyIMzghPeLIvMy9t7TOBgxNKDRHEyBjmIcQCW2YkAHg9UgzhgYxkTIvI0XTcREQQdsz49vJbZi_f6ctfjA2p4TkURFo0J9bvKSj3QZVi-_0grLu8r7ef9jBSitu5PMCRHcfE4_8024kLA==) . Information on accessing and registering for the webcast will be available beginning today.


A webcast replay of the discussion will be made available on our website at[Eversource's Investors page](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=w4IzImjn5hyIMzghPeLIvMy9t7TOBgxNKDRHEyBjmIfdqYVkrHLPh1XVM8o-wO2KJIKu920D6xd62G1Yw82CN9KXaxu60tKLXDQ9egR7W9SHtgbX-hASCWC47c28txJMznq466hYP8GHzzmNAkvSTA==) after the end of the live discussion and will be accessible for at least 90 days.


*Eversource (NYSE: ES), celebrated as a national leader for its commitment to sustainability and corporate citizenship, is named among America’s Most Responsible Companies by*[Newsweek](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=7xjoKfS3PrgmYRj4tEkCsSDVAl0m0A_aEVk5aeD4lefiG1bi9VCx5F5wgiUpweI5KjW3amrui5A6qeqEqojwPPTzXjhyS6JBbuExVwWuugHpdZ-viFFM-xh67Fe9Pfc3p2fA2TN0NMCFs3qWvzzk0g==) *for 2026 and recognized as the #1 utility on*[USA Today](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Bild6cB-MZ_3tNUq2sBDQbtdLV_-7rfBpqCy-WS6Zu37mssM4x6lA9s6dnjn0uCBRgI74NHlB20vyg-2ukZ0gyGKU9WzKMvwo-g28l3LgEjgU_M7qiMav7ROgsTjjes8ZmhQIA7gDN78R6K7_WtnU8gscQOGGUCI1d_ZfIR7taTNfx95ti_oJsGMVYc7jmH3) *’s list of America’s Climate Leaders for 2025.* *Eversource transmits and delivers electricity and natural gas to approximately 4 million customers in Connecticut, Massachusetts and New Hampshire. The #1 Energy Efficiency Provider in the Nation, Eversource harnesses the commitment of more than 10,500 employees across three states to build a single, united company around the mission of safely delivering reliable energy and water with superior customer service. The company is empowering a clean energy future in the Northeast, with nationally recognized energy efficiency solutions and successful programs to integrate new clean energy resources like a first-in-the-nation networked geothermal pilot project, solar, offshore wind, electric vehicles and battery storage, into the electric system. For more information, please visit*[eversource.com](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=3oUTb39hhpZlAg4Aodv0J2RHlvxpCp4I5wq9vli6PADRN9-FmpbAlGX2XJUtCumLIMJ1OeE3Lo4q6cWs2Oe4DQ==) *, and follow us on*[X](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=EHKUR_1ywwsqgOO6qLmzk6neMzq3jYBEgtskiUdKKX6GZjetVmYh2SIhvoYg0tz-JRTKQvkhQd5y1aQSrUn3Tg==) *,*[Facebook](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=4HHnjlnhQ71B836vLQySdiQaUgvOiJCXzghdAcs8-QQNQFwWZ1mP3M3GoxX5Jq0UIaoV4xfq6KBu36NHn6SX8OqW7euRd7QAIhnoXLGehEQ=) *,*[Instagram](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=RHoFO8Lmue7Qq02_PJjs51Q7VUgUPB_oRLCS4fTp7EDyiv2GgNjoKaXjb5tJn2oxKS_iYg1nJICOZVlExiMMFtOfBjssvDOYtkWebTSenjY=) *, and*[LinkedIn](https://www.globenewswire.com/Tracker?data=Pyk63HrpD9dSQ3lEzkw3t9lpS2cTmNl8NXyJuhVUZP0SkSajHztzKGZHXTrEcfoougXmwbHvmrstH8aW1wXE_l7ckitwXb_0aA1kEbfqE776NZF6xgOpult8T66yb_9H) *.*
